cond_0001.intro: Prepare, analyze, and maintain budget forecast information related to customer rebates (Trade Promotion Allowances - TPAs) and other sales related expenses to provide the sales force and management with timely information and reporting. Properly account for customer rebates (TPAs) via payment method and accrual preparation/tracking.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Customer Rebates
Work closely with the Sales Managers to capture new customers (accounts) within financial Account Trackers (update and maintain monthly). This requires updating latest forecast, year-to-date spending, and contract/agreement terms, as well as communication of program attainment to management.
Utilizing existing and new customer contracts, produce Account Adjustment Forms (customer check/credit memos) for Sales team and codify to conform to prescribed method for maintenance of records. Maintain annual updates and existing item allowance budget changes. Create new item names and system entry for budgeting purposes.
Inform Management of changes to customer contracts to ensure appropriate recognition of customer rebate expenses (trade promotion allowances) in the financial statements and forecast amendments.
Monitor and record deductions taken by customers. Obtain and validate adequate backup, log information in the Open Deduction database and send Open Deduction forms and backup to the Sales Managers for disposition (e.g., dispute resolution or credit memo issuance).
Analyze, prepare, and manage the review of the monthly Open Deduction report with A/R.
Manage Trade Promotion Allowance (customer rebate) Accrual processing to include creating annual forms, payment tracking, monthly and quarterly reviews with Sales and Finance and communication of updates for monthly meetings.
Prepare annual TPA budget with comparison analysis and explanation for variances.
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual customer program incentive reports.
Other Sales Analysis
Prepare monthly reconciliation of regional sales department budget spending.
Support initiatives which leverage technology to promote process change, to increase efficiency and clearly articulate the business requirements for ongoing improvements required to reinforce Account Management for all members of the Sales Organization.
Manage Display Budget Analysis including ongoing maintenance with Purchasing and Finance departments.
Prepare reports and analyses on an ad hoc basis to include reference summaries of customer shipments, annual sales and inventory status of displays assortment, and history of sample orders for budgetary purposes.
Assist and backup for projects in support of sales initiatives as needed.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree plus up to seven years sales accounting experience in a sales environment.
Excellent mathematical ability and advanced knowledge of Excel, as well as strong proofreading skills.
Strong quantitative, accounting, and analytical skills.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Access and PowerPoint.
Ability to communicate effectively and tactfully.
Highly organized and meticulous.
Ability to multi-task and prioritize effectively.
Preferred Requirements
Accounting degree.
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

cond_0010.intro: We are looking for a Financial Analyst to join our team.
cond_0010.responsibilities:
Customer Rebates
Work closely with the Sales Managers to capture new customers (accounts) within financial Account Trackers (update and maintain monthly). This requires updating latest forecast, year-to-date spending, and contract/agreement terms, as well as communication of program attainment to management.
Utilizing existing and new customer contracts, produce Account Adjustment Forms (customer check/credit memos) for Sales team and codify to conform to prescribed method for maintenance of records. Maintain annual updates and existing item allowance budget changes. Create new item names and system entry for budgeting purposes.
Inform Management of changes to customer contracts to ensure appropriate recognition of customer rebate expenses (trade promotion allowances) in the financial statements and forecast amendments.
Monitor and record deductions taken by customers. Obtain and validate adequate backup, log information in the Open Deduction database and send Open Deduction forms and backup to the Sales Managers for disposition (e.g., dispute resolution or credit memo issuance).
Analyze, prepare, and manage the review of the monthly Open Deduction report with A/R.
Manage Trade Promotion Allowance (customer rebate) Accrual processing to include creating annual forms, payment tracking, monthly and quarterly reviews with Sales and Finance and communication of updates for monthly meetings.
Prepare annual TPA budget with comparison analysis and explanation for variances.
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual customer program incentive reports.
Other Sales Analysis
Prepare monthly reconciliation of regional sales department budget spending.
Support initiatives which leverage technology to promote process change, to increase efficiency and clearly articulate the business requirements for ongoing improvements required to reinforce Account Management for all members of the Sales Organization.
Manage Display Budget Analysis including ongoing maintenance with Purchasing and Finance departments.
Prepare reports and analyses on an ad hoc basis to include reference summaries of customer shipments, annual sales and inventory status of displays assortment, and history of sample orders for budgetary purposes.
Assist and backup for projects in support of sales initiatives as needed.
cond_0010.requirements:
Bachelor's degree plus up to seven years sales accounting experience in a fast-paced sales environment.
Accounting degree preferred.
Excellent mathematical ability and advanced knowledge of Excel, as well as strong proofreading skills.
Strong quantitative, accounting, and analytical skills.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Access and PowerPoint required.
Ability to communicate effectively and tactfully.
Highly organized and meticulous.
Ability to multi-task and prioritize effectively.

cond_0019.responsibilities:
Customer Rebates
Work closely with the Sales Managers to capture new customers (accounts) within financial Account Trackers (update and maintain monthly). This requires updating latest forecast, year-to-date spending, and contract/agreement terms, as well as communication of program attainment to management.
Utilizing existing and new customer contracts, produce Account Adjustment Forms (customer check/credit memos) for Sales team and codify to conform to prescribed method for maintenance of records. Maintain annual updates and existing item allowance budget changes. Create new item names and system entry for budgeting purposes.
Inform Management of changes to customer contracts to ensure appropriate recognition of customer rebate expenses (trade promotion allowances) in the financial statements and forecast amendments.
Monitor and record deductions taken by customers. Obtain and validate adequate backup, log information in the Open Deduction database and send Open Deduction forms and backup to the Sales Managers for disposition (e.g., dispute resolution or credit memo issuance).
Analyze, prepare, and manage the review of the monthly Open Deduction report with A/R.
Manage Trade Promotion Allowance (customer rebate) Accrual processing to include creating annual forms, payment tracking, monthly and quarterly reviews with Sales and Finance and communication of updates for monthly meetings.
Prepare annual TPA budget with comparison analysis and explanation for variances.
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual customer program incentive reports.
Other Sales Analysis
Prepare monthly reconciliation of regional sales department budget spending.
Support initiatives which leverage technology to promote process change, to increase efficiency and clearly articulate the business requirements for ongoing improvements required to reinforce Account Management for all members of the Sales Organization.
Manage Display Budget Analysis including ongoing maintenance with Purchasing and Finance departments.
Prepare reports and analyses on an ad hoc basis to include reference summaries of customer shipments, annual sales and inventory status of displays assortment, and history of sample orders for budgetary purposes.
Assist and backup for projects in support of sales initiatives as needed.
cond_0019.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree plus up to seven years sales accounting experience in a sales environment.
Excellent mathematical ability and advanced knowledge of Excel, as well as strong proofreading skills.
Strong quantitative, accounting, and analytical skills.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Access and PowerPoint.
Ability to communicate effectively and tactfully.
Highly organized and meticulous.
Ability to multi-task and prioritize effectively.
Preferred Requirements
Accounting degree.

cond_0038.intro:
We are looking for someone to join our team in this role.
Prepare, analyze, and maintain budget forecast information related to customer rebates (Trade Promotion Allowances - TPAs) and other sales related expenses to provide the sales force and management with timely information and reporting. Properly account for customer rebates (TPAs) via payment method and accrual preparation/tracking.
cond_0038.responsibilities:
Customer Rebates
Work closely with the Sales Managers to capture new customers (accounts) within financial Account Trackers (update and maintain monthly). This requires updating latest forecast, year-to-date spending, and contract/agreement terms, as well as communication of program attainment to management.
Utilizing existing and new customer contracts, produce Account Adjustment Forms (customer check/credit memos) for Sales team and codify to conform to prescribed method for maintenance of records. Maintain annual updates and existing item allowance budget changes. Create new item names and system entry for budgeting purposes.
Inform Management of changes to customer contracts to ensure appropriate recognition of customer rebate expenses (trade promotion allowances) in the financial statements and forecast amendments.
Monitor and record deductions taken by customers. Obtain and validate adequate backup, log information in the Open Deduction database and send Open Deduction forms and backup to the Sales Managers for disposition (e.g., dispute resolution or credit memo issuance).
Analyze, prepare, and manage the review of the monthly Open Deduction report with A/R.
Manage Trade Promotion Allowance (customer rebate) Accrual processing to include creating annual forms, payment tracking, monthly and quarterly reviews with Sales and Finance and communication of updates for monthly meetings.
Prepare annual TPA budget with comparison analysis and explanation for variances.
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual customer program incentive reports.
Other Sales Analysis
Prepare monthly reconciliation of regional sales department budget spending.
Support initiatives which leverage technology to promote process change, to increase efficiency and clearly articulate the business requirements for ongoing improvements required to reinforce Account Management for all members of the Sales Organization.
Manage Display Budget Analysis including ongoing maintenance with Purchasing and Finance departments.
Prepare reports and analyses on an ad hoc basis to include reference summaries of customer shipments, annual sales and inventory status of displays assortment, and history of sample orders for budgetary purposes.
Assist and backup for projects in support of sales initiatives as needed.
cond_0038.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field required; accounting degree strongly preferred.
Up to seven years of demonstrated expertise in sales accounting.
Exceptional mathematical ability and advanced expertise in Excel, along with strong proofreading skills.

Deep knowledge of Microsoft Access and PowerPoint.
Highly organized and meticulous, with the ability to manage competing priorities without loss of quality.

cond_0117.intro: We are looking for someone to join our team in this role. Working closely with Sales and Finance, you will help prepare, analyze, and maintain budget forecast information related to customer rebates (Trade Promotion Allowances - TPAs) and other sales-related expenses. You will support the sales force and management with timely information and reporting, and help ensure customer rebates are properly accounted for through payment and accrual preparation and tracking.
cond_0117.responsibilities:
Customer Rebates
Work closely with the Sales Managers to capture new customers (accounts) within financial Account Trackers (update and maintain monthly). This involves coordinating on the latest forecast, year-to-date spending, and contract/agreement terms, as well as sharing program attainment updates with management.
Using existing and new customer contracts, prepare Account Adjustment Forms (customer check/credit memos) in coordination with the Sales team and codify to conform to prescribed method for maintenance of records. Maintain annual updates and existing item allowance budget changes. Create new item names and system entry for budgeting purposes.
Keep Management informed of changes to customer contracts to help ensure appropriate recognition of customer rebate expenses (trade promotion allowances) in the financial statements and forecast amendments.
Monitor and record deductions taken by customers. Obtain and validate adequate backup, log information in the Open Deduction database and send Open Deduction forms and backup to the Sales Managers for disposition (e.g., dispute resolution or credit memo issuance).
Analyze, prepare, and coordinate the review of the monthly Open Deduction report with A/R.
Support Trade Promotion Allowance (customer rebate) Accrual processing, including creating annual forms, payment tracking, and conducting monthly and quarterly reviews together with Sales and Finance, and sharing updates for monthly meetings.
Prepare annual TPA budget with comparison analysis and explanation for variances.
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual customer program incentive reports.
Other Sales Analysis
Prepare monthly reconciliation of regional sales department budget spending.
Support initiatives which leverage technology to promote process change, to increase efficiency and clearly articulate the business requirements for ongoing improvements required to reinforce Account Management for all members of the Sales Organization.
Coordinate Display Budget Analysis including ongoing maintenance with Purchasing and Finance departments.
Prepare reports and analyses on an ad hoc basis to include reference summaries of customer shipments, annual sales and inventory status of displays assortment, and history of sample orders for budgetary purposes.
Assist and backup for projects in support of sales initiatives as needed.
cond_0117.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree plus up to seven years sales accounting experience in a sales environment.
Excellent mathematical ability and advanced knowledge of Excel, as well as strong proofreading skills.
Strong quantitative, accounting, and analytical skills.
Ability to communicate effectively and tactfully.
Highly organized and meticulous.
Ability to multi-task and prioritize effectively.
Preferred Requirements
Accounting degree.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Access and PowerPoint.

cond_0275.intro: We are looking for someone to join our team in this role. The position involves preparing, analyzing, and maintaining budget forecast information related to customer rebates (Trade Promotion Allowances - TPAs) and other sales related expenses to provide the sales force and management with timely information and reporting. The role also covers properly accounting for customer rebates (TPAs) via payment method and accrual preparation/tracking. People usually grow into this kind of financial analysis work over time as they build experience with sales accounting and reporting.
cond_0275.responsibilities:
Customer Rebates
Work closely with the Sales Managers to capture new customers (accounts) within financial Account Trackers (update and maintain monthly). This requires updating latest forecast, year-to-date spending, and contract/agreement terms, as well as communication of program attainment to management.
Utilizing existing and new customer contracts, produce Account Adjustment Forms (customer check/credit memos) for Sales team and codify to conform to prescribed method for maintenance of records. Maintain annual updates and existing item allowance budget changes. Create new item names and system entry for budgeting purposes.
Inform Management of changes to customer contracts to ensure appropriate recognition of customer rebate expenses (trade promotion allowances) in the financial statements and forecast amendments.
Monitor and record deductions taken by customers. Obtain and validate adequate backup, log information in the Open Deduction database and send Open Deduction forms and backup to the Sales Managers for disposition (e.g., dispute resolution or credit memo issuance).
Analyze, prepare, and manage the review of the monthly Open Deduction report with A/R.
Manage Trade Promotion Allowance (customer rebate) Accrual processing to include creating annual forms, payment tracking, monthly and quarterly reviews with Sales and Finance and communication of updates for monthly meetings.
Prepare annual TPA budget with comparison analysis and explanation for variances.
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual customer program incentive reports.
Other Sales Analysis
Prepare monthly reconciliation of regional sales department budget spending.
Support initiatives which leverage technology to promote process change, to increase efficiency and clearly articulate the business requirements for ongoing improvements required to reinforce Account Management for all members of the Sales Organization.
Manage Display Budget Analysis including ongoing maintenance with Purchasing and Finance departments.
Prepare reports and analyses on an ad hoc basis to include reference summaries of customer shipments, annual sales and inventory status of displays assortment, and history of sample orders for budgetary purposes.
Assist and backup for projects in support of sales initiatives as needed.
cond_0275.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree plus up to seven years sales accounting experience in a sales environment.
Excellent mathematical ability and advanced knowledge of Excel, as well as strong proofreading skills.
Strong quantitative, accounting, and analytical skills.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Access and PowerPoint.
Ability to communicate effectively and tactfully.
Highly organized and meticulous.
Ability to multi-task and prioritize effectively.
Preferred Requirements
Accounting degree.

Customer Rebates
Work closely with the Sales Managers to capture new customers (accounts) within financial Account Trackers (update and maintain monthly). This requires updating latest forecast, year-to-date spending, and contract/agreement terms, as well as communication of program attainment to management.
Utilizing existing and new customer contracts, produce Account Adjustment Forms (customer check/credit memos) for Sales team and codify to conform to prescribed method for maintenance of records. Prepare annual TPA budget with comparison analysis and explanation for variances.

Prepare monthly reconciliation of regional sales department budget spending.
Support initiatives which leverage technology to promote process change, to increase efficiency and clearly articulate the business requirements for ongoing improvements required to reinforce Account Management for all members of the Sales Organization.

Prepare reports and analyses on an ad hoc basis to include reference summaries of customer shipments, annual sales and inventory status of displays assortment, and history of sample orders for budgetary purposes.

cond_0375.intro: We are looking for someone to join our team in this role. The position involves preparing, analyzing, and maintaining budget forecast information related to customer rebates (Trade Promotion Allowances - TPAs) and other sales-related expenses. You will work closely with the sales force and management to provide timely information and reporting, and handle customer rebate accounting through payment and accrual preparation and tracking.
cond_0375.responsibilities:
Customer Rebates
Work closely with the Sales Managers on a regular basis to capture new customers (accounts) within financial Account Trackers (update and maintain monthly). This involves updating the latest forecast, year-to-date spending, and contract/agreement terms, and communicating program attainment to management.
Using existing and new customer contracts, produce Account Adjustment Forms (customer check/credit memos) for the Sales team and codify to conform to prescribed method for maintenance of records. Maintain annual updates and existing item allowance budget changes. Create new item names and system entry for budgeting purposes.
Keep Management informed of changes to customer contracts to ensure appropriate recognition of customer rebate expenses (trade promotion allowances) in the financial statements and forecast amendments.
Monitor and record deductions taken by customers. Obtain and validate adequate backup, log information in the Open Deduction database, and send Open Deduction forms and backup to the Sales Managers for disposition (e.g., dispute resolution or credit memo issuance).
Analyze, prepare, and actively participate in the monthly Open Deduction report review with A/R.
Manage Trade Promotion Allowance (customer rebate) Accrual processing, including creating annual forms, payment tracking, and leading monthly and quarterly reviews with Sales and Finance, with regular communication of updates for monthly meetings.
Prepare annual TPA budget with comparison analysis and explanation for variances.
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual customer program incentive reports.
Other Sales Analysis
Prepare monthly reconciliation of regional sales department budget spending.
Support initiatives that leverage technology to promote process change and increase efficiency, and clearly articulate business requirements for ongoing improvements to reinforce Account Management for all members of the Sales Organization.
Manage Display Budget Analysis including ongoing maintenance with Purchasing and Finance departments.
Prepare reports and analyses on an ad hoc basis, including reference summaries of customer shipments, annual sales and inventory status of displays assortment, and history of sample orders for budgetary purposes.
Assist and back up projects in support of sales initiatives as needed.
cond_0375.requirements:
Bachelor's degree plus up to seven years of sales accounting experience.
Accounting degree preferred.
Excellent mathematical ability and advanced knowledge of Excel, as well as strong proofreading skills.
Strong quantitative, accounting, and analytical skills.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Access and PowerPoint required.
Ability to communicate effectively and tactfully, including explaining findings and walking colleagues through analysis.
Highly organized and meticulous.
Ability to multi-task and prioritize effectively.

Prepare, analyze, and maintain budget forecast information related to customer rebates (Trade Promotion Allowances - TPAs) and other sales related expenses to provide the sales force and management with timely information and reporting. Properly account for customer rebates (TPAs) via payment method and accrual preparation/tracking.
cond_0417.responsibilities:
Customer Rebates
Work closely with the Sales Managers to capture new customers (accounts) within financial Account Trackers (update and maintain monthly). This requires updating latest forecast, year-to-date spending, and contract/agreement terms, as well as communication of program attainment to management.
Utilizing existing and new customer contracts, produce Account Adjustment Forms (customer check/credit memos) for Sales team and codify to conform to prescribed method for maintenance of records. Maintain annual updates and existing item allowance budget changes. Create new item names and system entry for budgeting purposes.
Inform Management of changes to customer contracts to ensure appropriate recognition of customer rebate expenses (trade promotion allowances) in the financial statements and forecast amendments.
Monitor and record deductions taken by customers. Obtain and validate adequate backup, log information in the Open Deduction database and send Open Deduction forms and backup to the Sales Managers for disposition (e.g., dispute resolution or credit memo issuance).
Analyze, prepare, and manage the review of the monthly Open Deduction report with A/R.
Manage Trade Promotion Allowance (customer rebate) Accrual processing to include creating annual forms, payment tracking, monthly and quarterly reviews with Sales and Finance and communication of updates for monthly meetings.
Prepare annual TPA budget with comparison analysis and explanation for variances.
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual customer program incentive reports.
Other Sales Analysis
Prepare monthly reconciliation of regional sales department budget spending.
Support initiatives which leverage technology to promote process change, to increase efficiency and clearly articulate the business requirements for ongoing improvements required to reinforce Account Management for all members of the Sales Organization.
Manage Display Budget Analysis including ongoing maintenance with Purchasing and Finance departments.
Prepare reports and analyses on an ad hoc basis to include reference summaries of customer shipments, annual sales and inventory status of displays assortment, and history of sample orders for budgetary purposes.
Assist and backup for projects in support of sales initiatives as needed.
cond_0417.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience.
Around seven years of sales accounting experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Comfort with Excel, including working knowledge of its more advanced features, along with solid proofreading skills.
Background in quantitative, accounting, and analytical work.
Ability to communicate effectively and tactfully.
Preferred Requirements
Accounting degree.
Familiarity with Microsoft Access and PowerPoint.
Organized and detail-oriented approach to work.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and shift priorities as needed.
cond_0417.values: We value excellence and take pride in delivering strong results. We aim to hold a high standard in our work and in the outcomes we create.

This role focuses on preparing, analyzing, and maintaining budget forecast information related to customer rebates (Trade Promotion Allowances - TPAs) and other sales-related expenses. The work involves providing the sales force and management with timely information and reporting, and properly accounting for customer rebates via payment method and accrual preparation/tracking.
cond_0529.responsibilities:
Customer Rebates
Coordinate with Sales Managers to capture new customers (accounts) within financial Account Trackers (update and maintain monthly). This includes updating the latest forecast, year-to-date spending, and contract/agreement terms, and reporting program attainment to management.
Using existing and new customer contracts, produce Account Adjustment Forms (customer check/credit memos) for the Sales team and codify to conform to prescribed record-keeping methods. Maintain annual updates and existing item allowance budget changes. Create new item names and system entries for budgeting purposes.
Notify Management of changes to customer contracts to ensure appropriate recognition of customer rebate expenses (trade promotion allowances) in the financial statements and forecast amendments.
Monitor and record deductions taken by customers. Obtain and validate adequate backup, log information in the Open Deduction database, and send Open Deduction forms and backup to Sales Managers for disposition (e.g., dispute resolution or credit memo issuance).
Analyze, prepare, and manage the monthly Open Deduction report review with A/R.
Manage Trade Promotion Allowance (customer rebate) Accrual processing, including creating annual forms, payment tracking, monthly and quarterly reviews with Sales and Finance, and sharing updates for monthly meetings.
Prepare the annual TPA budget with comparison analysis and explanation of variances.
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual customer program incentive reports.
Other Sales Analysis
Prepare monthly reconciliation of regional sales department budget spending.
Support initiatives that use technology to drive process change, increase efficiency, and document business requirements for ongoing improvements to Account Management across the Sales Organization.
Manage Display Budget Analysis including ongoing maintenance with Purchasing and Finance departments.
Prepare reports and analyses on an ad hoc basis, including reference summaries of customer shipments, annual sales and inventory status of displays assortment, and history of sample orders for budgetary purposes.
Assist with and provide backup for projects in support of sales initiatives as needed.
cond_0529.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree plus up to seven years of sales accounting experience.
Strong quantitative, accounting, and analytical skills.
Excellent mathematical ability and advanced knowledge of Excel, as well as strong proofreading skills.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Access and PowerPoint.
Highly organized and meticulous.
Ability to multi-task and prioritize effectively.
Preferred Requirements
Accounting degree.
Ability to communicate clearly and tactfully in written and verbal form.
cond_0529.workplace_support: We believe growth happens in supportive environments, not in isolation. Through mentorship, collaboration, and shared accountability, we create space for employees to learn, contribute, and succeed.

cond_0561.intro:
We are looking for someone to join our team in this role.
Prepare, analyze, and maintain budget forecast information related to customer rebates (Trade Promotion Allowances - TPAs) and other sales related expenses to provide the sales force and management with timely information and reporting. Properly account for customer rebates (TPAs) via payment method and accrual preparation/tracking.
cond_0561.responsibilities:
Customer Rebates
Work closely with the Sales Managers to capture new customers (accounts) within financial Account Trackers (update and maintain monthly). This requires updating latest forecast, year-to-date spending, and contract/agreement terms, as well as communication of program attainment to management.
Utilizing existing and new customer contracts, produce Account Adjustment Forms (customer check/credit memos) for Sales team and codify to conform to prescribed method for maintenance of records. Maintain annual updates and existing item allowance budget changes. Create new item names and system entry for budgeting purposes.
Inform Management of changes to customer contracts to ensure appropriate recognition of customer rebate expenses (trade promotion allowances) in the financial statements and forecast amendments.
Monitor and record deductions taken by customers. Obtain and validate adequate backup, log information in the Open Deduction database and send Open Deduction forms and backup to the Sales Managers for disposition (e.g., dispute resolution or credit memo issuance).
Analyze, prepare, and manage the review of the monthly Open Deduction report with A/R.
Manage Trade Promotion Allowance (customer rebate) Accrual processing to include creating annual forms, payment tracking, monthly and quarterly reviews with Sales and Finance and communication of updates for monthly meetings.
Prepare annual TPA budget with comparison analysis and explanation for variances.
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual customer program incentive reports.
Other Sales Analysis
Prepare monthly reconciliation of regional sales department budget spending.
Support initiatives which leverage technology to promote process change, to increase efficiency and clearly articulate the business requirements for ongoing improvements required to reinforce Account Management for all members of the Sales Organization.
Manage Display Budget Analysis including ongoing maintenance with Purchasing and Finance departments.
Prepare reports and analyses on an ad hoc basis to include reference summaries of customer shipments, annual sales and inventory status of displays assortment, and history of sample orders for budgetary purposes.
Assist and backup for projects in support of sales initiatives as needed.
cond_0561.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience.
Around seven years of sales accounting experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Comfort with Excel, including working knowledge of its more advanced features, along with solid proofreading skills.
Background in quantitative, accounting, and analytical work.
Ability to communicate effectively and tactfully.
Preferred Requirements
Accounting degree.
Familiarity with Microsoft Access and PowerPoint.
Organized and detail-oriented approach to work.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and shift priorities as needed.
